single_variable: Cross-venue test of the exact high-growth OKX account. On the same 680-contract Binance data and with identical seed/size, compare original 12H-expiring targets to the one new change, 20% of marked NAV maximum per contract at eligible 12H closes. No frozen model scores or funding-driven priority. No cap/threshold tuning.
account: Start 1000U, nine shared unlevered slots, NAV/9 maximum allocation, 2/3 at 2R while the target remains valid during the first 12 hours only, remainder follows the native stop and EMA20/50 exit. Same V1.7 12H-confirmed key and coincident native H1 open, Binance full studied archive through 2026-09-23, corrected contract lifetimes, market fees 5bp and resting targets 2bp. Holding funding, impact and minimum tradable lots excluded.
interpretation: Improvements in absolute wealth, net cash payoff, win rate, observed and conservative drawdown are compared within venue. Binance later periods and expanded constituent archive were previously explored. The source 20% cap was motivated by a scored Binance long, so the Binance rerun checks transfer across portfolio rules; it is not an untouched test.
